we developed the first ovine BAC library, constructed the first ovine MHC BAC-based physical contigs, and ordered and oriented most BAC clones within each contig.
we developed the first physical map of the ovine major histo-compatibility complex (MCH).
a BAC-based ovine MHC physical map has been constructed and that the minimum tiling paths are approximately 1900 kb, 400 kb, and 300kb.

the development of a high resolution physical map of ovines MHC, which is the first step in the construction of a complete map.
the development of a BAC-based map of the ovine MHC.
the construction of a BAC-based map of the ovine MHC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ovine MHC map is now well established.
the ovine MHC is composed of at least three regions, namely, MHC class I, class II, and class III.
the MHC is a complex and highly conserved region of the genome that is involved in the regulation of the immune system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have constructed a BAC-based map for the ovines MHC.
we have constructed a BAC library and a BAC-based map for the ovines MHC.
the BAC-based physical mapping of ovine MLC has been successfully accomplished.

the MHC region of sheep is very similar to the MHC region in humans and other mammals.
